mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 69 degrees, feeling like 74, all under a new moon.

The City Clerk is preparing for the fall elections, and residents should note that road construction on Highway M begins August 18, which will shift traffic patterns and include some driveway closures.

Today, you can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy free music at Concerts in the Park, or test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia, with live music starting tomorrow at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On August 6, an officer arrested a driver for an O W I, fourth offence, after observing erratic driving.
Today's delicious flavor is Devil's Food Cake. The shop is currently closed but will open at 10 AM, and tomorrow you can look forward to Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough.
